## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `type/short-description` (`feat`, `minor`, `fix`, `refactor` or `docs`).
- [ ] The PR does one thing, with fewer than 500 changed lines and fewer than 100 files.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and the checks from CONTRIBUTING.md pass locally.
- [ ] Texts go through i18n in English and Spanish.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and docs are updated if users will notice the change.
